modules.title: Reading & Vocabulary
modules.description: Learn new words, spelling, and how to read smoothly.

questions.question: Which word is spelled correctly?
questions.explanation: A-P-P-L-E. An apple a day keeps the doctor away! 🍎

questions.question: What is the opposite of 'Happy'?
questions.explanation: The opposite of being happy is being sad. 😢

questions.question: What does the word 'Enormous' mean?
questions.explanation: Enormous means something is HUGE, like an elephant! 🐘

questions.question: Which word is a synonym for 'Beautiful'?
questions.explanation: A synonym means 'the same thing'. Gorgeous and Beautiful mean the same thing!

modules.title: Sentence Building & Comprehension
modules.description: Construct sentences properly and understand stories.

questions.question: Choose the best word: 'The cat ____ on the mat.'
questions.explanation: Cats like to sit! 'The cat sat on the mat.'

questions.question: What needs to go at the end of a question?
questions.explanation: Whenever you ask something, put a question mark (?) at the end.

questions.question: Put these in order: [dog] [The] [barked]
questions.explanation: Always start with the subject! The dog did what? It barked.

questions.question: Read: 'Tim got a red bike for his birthday.' What color is the bike?
questions.explanation: The story says he got a 'red bike'. You found the clue!
